description: Renders raw HTML/CSS to a stored PNG/JPG/WebP/PDF via POST /v1/images (2 credits; requires OGMAKE_API_KEY). JavaScript never runs; at most 3 external http(s) subresources load, each through an SSRF-safe fetcher; the request body is limited to 300 KB. Returns the hosted URL plus an inline preview.

css.description: Extra CSS, injected as a <style> block.

html.description: HTML document or fragment to render.

name: render_html
title: Render HTML to an image
